page.notes: Printed page signature "S 4" at the foot is a gathering mark. Doubtful readings: the Greek in XII ("Ζῶσ φωνῆς μεί- ζων ἐνέργεια") is set in a smaller form and may be imperfect; the word after "styli" is partly obscured by the gutter shadow and "&" at the line end is read from the scan. Some long-s words are rendered with s in the printed page; the transcription uses plain s as per the rules, so "solet" etc. are given with s. The line "nando ferius..." is a fragment at the page head and is marked cont="true". The final line ends with "&" as printed. Page number and running head are read from the scan.
